issues.desc: INIT correctly bounds Wave 1 to additive schema and observe-only diagnostics, but it does not yet state one concrete user-observable completion path: CHK-001/002/004 are internal mechanics and CHK-003 defers renderer placement to PLAN. During PLAN, bind the renderer to a named read-only CLI/status surface and define a completion demonstration showing a topology-enabled Story, a legacy Story, stable source IDs, deterministic diagnostics, and unchanged lifecycle transitions; otherwise the user cannot unambiguously recognize Wave 1 as delivered.
